Is a variant in the LD Store?

Source: R/ld-reflookup.R
og_ld_reflookup.Rd

og_ld_reflookup() says whether each of variants is held by an LD Store, so you can check instruments before clumping or building an LD matrix. See vignette("ld").

Usage

og_ld_reflookup(src, variants, ld = NULL)

Arguments

src

A Source, from og_api().

variants

ALIDs and rsIDs, or a data frame of Associations.

ld

An LD Store's name, an ancestry code (its LD Store), or NULL to match the Assigned Ancestry of the Associations' Analyses. LD Stores only: a PLINK Reference is refused.

Value

A data frame with og_provenance() attached (ld, ld_choice, absent), one row per variant asked, in the order asked: alid, rsid (NA where not known: an ALID given without an rsid column) and present.

Details

variants and ld are as for og_ld_proxies(); an LD Store can only be named, not a PLINK Reference. An rsID stands for every ALID it names, one row each; an rsID no GWAS Store holds has one row with alid NA and present FALSE. A variant the LD Store doesn't hold is a row, not a warning. One Job takes at most 10,000 variants; more are split.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
src <- og_api()
og_ld_reflookup(src, c("16:53767042:C:T", "rs1421085"), ld = "EUR")
} # }
